name: Tech Blue Business
tagline: White corporate canvas with tech-blue accents, a sparing blue gradient band and consistent line icons drawn in inline SVG. Original slides-commons design.

palette.description: white canvas, navy ink, one tech-blue family with a pale tint for icon tiles; the navy-to-cyan gradient appears only as the cover/closing band and one highlight per slide

typography.style: modern geometric sans in 400-800 for headlines and body, IBM Plex Mono for uppercase labels, codes, dates and section numbers; tabular figures for metrics and tables

best_for: Company introductions, solution proposals and B2B pitches in technology, logistics, manufacturing and services: agenda, company overview, capability icon grid, layered architecture diagram, delivery process, case study with metrics, Gantt roadmap, service tier matrix, client logo wall, contact slide. Works well for Chinese corporate decks.
avoid_for: Emotional storytelling, creative or lifestyle brands, academic talks and anything that should feel handmade or editorial. The look is deliberately corporate.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
